title: CRC-32C of byte buffers
summary: Compute the CRC-32C (Castagnoli, as used by iSCSI, ext4, Btrfs, SCTP and cloud object stores) of a buffer of bytes as an unsigned 32-bit number.
notes: Inputs are hex strings, because fixtures are shared as JSON; every adapter turns them into bytes in prepare, before any timing, so the measured call checksums bytes only.
